signature: SUBROUTINE DLASD7( ICOMPQ, NL, NR, SQRE, K, D, Z, ZW, VF, VFW, VL,

params.name: icompq
params.reference:
Specifies whether singular vectors are to be computed in compact form, as follows:

-   `= 0`: Compute singular values only.
-   `= 1`: Compute singular vectors of upper bidiagonal matrix in compact form.

params.name: nl
params.reference: The row dimension of the upper block. $\mathrm{NL} \ge 1$.

params.name: nr
params.reference: The row dimension of the lower block. $\mathrm{NR} \ge 1$.

params.name: sqre
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: the lower block is an `NR`-by-`NR` square matrix.
-   `= 1`: the lower block is an `NR`-by-(`NR`+1) rectangular matrix.

The bidiagonal matrix has $N = \mathrm{NL} + \mathrm{NR} + 1$ rows and $M = N + \mathrm{SQRE} \ge N$ columns.

params.name: k
params.reference: Contains the dimension of the non-deflated matrix, this is the order of the related secular equation. $1 \le K \le N$.

params.name: d
params.reference: On entry D contains the singular values of the two submatrices to be combined. On exit D contains the trailing (N-K) updated singular values (those which were deflated) sorted into increasing order.

params.name: z
params.reference: On exit Z contains the updating row vector in the secular equation.

params.name: ZW
params.reference: Workspace for Z.

params.name: VF
params.reference: On entry, `VF(1:NL+1)` contains the first components of all right singular vectors of the upper block; and `VF(NL+2:M)` contains the first components of all right singular vectors of the lower block. On exit, `VF` contains the first components of all right singular vectors of the bidiagonal matrix.

params.name: VFW
params.reference: Workspace for `VF`.

params.name: VL
params.reference: On entry, `VL(1:NL+1)` contains the last components of all right singular vectors of the upper block; and `VL(NL+2:M)` contains the last components of all right singular vectors of the lower block. On exit, `VL` contains the last components of all right singular vectors of the bidiagonal matrix.

params.name: VLW
params.reference: Workspace for `VL`.

params.name: alpha
params.reference: Contains the diagonal element associated with the added row.

params.name: beta
params.reference: Contains the off-diagonal element associated with the added row.

params.name: DSIGMA
params.reference: Contains a copy of the diagonal elements (K-1 singular values and one zero) in the secular equation.

params.name: IDX
params.reference: This will contain the permutation used to sort the contents of D into ascending order.

params.name: IDXP
params.reference: This will contain the permutation used to place deflated values of D at the end of the array. On output `IDXP(2:K)` points to the nondeflated D-values and `IDXP(K+1:N)` points to the deflated singular values.

params.name: IDXQ
params.reference: This contains the permutation which separately sorts the two sub-problems in D into ascending order. Note that entries in the first half of this permutation must first be moved one position backward; and entries in the second half must first have `NL`+1 added to their values.

params.name: PERM
params.reference: The permutations (from deflation and sorting) to be applied to each singular block. Not referenced if `ICOMPQ = 0`.

params.name: givptr
params.reference: The number of Givens rotations which took place in this subproblem. Not referenced if `ICOMPQ = 0`.

params.name: GIVCOL
params.reference: Each pair of numbers indicates a pair of columns to take place in a Givens rotation. Not referenced if `ICOMPQ = 0`.

params.name: ldgcol
params.reference: The leading dimension of `GIVCOL`, must be at least N.

params.name: GIVNUM
params.reference: Each number indicates the C or S value to be used in the corresponding Givens rotation. Not referenced if `ICOMPQ = 0`.

params.name: ldgnum
params.reference: The leading dimension of `GIVNUM`, must be at least N.

params.name: c
params.reference: C contains garbage if `SQRE =0` and the C-value of a Givens rotation related to the right null space if `SQRE = 1`.

params.name: s
params.reference: S contains garbage if `SQRE =0` and the S-value of a Givens rotation related to the right null space if `SQRE = 1`.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit.
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value.
